payload.thirtySeconds: MattF steals the net title at +6, hanging off KeithK75 by a shot while Dan94 lurks two back. Keith still owns the gross win at +4, because apparently hitting it best and still getting carded by Valhalla is a thing. The raw golf was mostly a bar fight: Keith smoked the tee game and the total SGT numbers, while MattF got dragged to the finish by absurd short game work and enough tee help to survive the chaos.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: MattF wins net as KeithK75 absolutely nukes Valhalla anyway
payload.stateOfLeague: This one reinforces the split between winning the event and hitting the ball best: MattF cashed the net trophy, but KeithK75’s gross form and SGT profile were the clearest elite signal in the field. It also keeps the recurring cast honest: the top end can post, but the difference between surviving and torching a course is still whether the putter and short game decide to join the trip or stay home.
